sections.text: تفكيك المضخة
Remove coupling cover.
افصل الاقتران.
Dismantle the electric motor and take it out.
Dismantle all attached pipes to the pump.
Dismount the half coupling of the pump shaft.
Unscrew the sleeve nut of the bearing and take it out
Screw out the nuts fixing the pedestal to the pump casing
Lift the pump to the work place and put it on its maintenance stand.
Loosen the clamping bolts and remove them from the pump.

Using snap ring pliers, remove retiring ring from thrust end of shaft by 
 notice.

قم بإزالة غدة الصواميل وحلقات تعبئة الفانوس وبطانات الصندوق.
Slide casing wear ring of impeller and shaft.
Remove rotary portion of both seals remove shaft sleeves.

محرك أو اضغط على المكره من رمح.

sections.text: حَشد
Place the suction casing with the bolted bearing pedestal on an assembly stand

Insert the shaft with mounted gland sleeves for the stuffing box and put it 
 into the bearing pedestal through the 
 stuffing box space of the suction casing and support the shaft from the other side.
Build in the radial bearing.

Fit the impeller and ensure that the inner front wall of the impeller channel 
 mates with he Surface of the diffuser 
 shim.

Put the pump in its place and mount all attached pipes.
Put the motor on its place.
Adjust the alignment between motor shaft and pump shaft and record them.

Before starting the pump, the following steps should be checked
Open the suction and delivery valves of the pump.

Check the direction of rotation of the pump by pushing the electric button of 
 the motor pump instantaneously.
